name: telegram
description: Read, cache, search, summarize, send, and manage Telegram chats from Codex.

interface.longDescription: Connect your personal Telegram account and let Codex summarize, search, send, and manage chats. Sync chats into a local cache for efficient repeat search, long-window summaries, and aggregates.
defaultPrompt: Summarize my unread Telegram messages from today
Sync/cache a Telegram chat, then search it for launch decisions
Aggregate cached Telegram history by sender this month
